detail.longDescription: Can anyone recommend good calendar and contact server software that supports WebDAV? I don't need a web interface, it just needs to work with GNOME Online Accounts. I tried to take a deep dive, but there are too many technical terms for my taste, making the topic harder to explore. My research so far has led me to Baïkal ( https:// sabre.io/baikal/ ) as the most promising contender. Nextcloud is too heavy for my taste. Help and advice appreciated :) # selfhost # selfhosted # calendar # caldav # webdav
